handoffSay.text: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Aurora Marshall is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Aurora Marshall is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Blanca blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Aurora Marshall, 16 days. The mantle passes to Blanca Jin.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Blanca Jin, 60 — a Wild food forager.
You knew Aurora — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
The fire knew Blanca — solid ground, earned at this fire.
